meta.title: Hondura · Dive centre in Arinaga, Gran Canaria
meta.description: Try dives, guided dives and PADI courses in the El Cabrón reserve, Arinaga (Gran Canaria). Small groups, certified instructors and insurance included.
meta.ogAlt: Dive boat moored beside a volcanic cliff, with two divers descending below the surface

hero.valor: Dive the volcanic coast of Gran Canaria with an instructor by your side and groups of four.
hero.alt: Dive boat moored beside a volcanic cliff at sunset; below the surface, two divers descend through rays of light

sebadal.texto: At eight metres the water turns turquoise and the seagrass meadow sways with the swell.
sebadal.alt: Seagrass meadow with a school of silver fish, a parrotfish and a diver in the distance under sunbeams

pecio.texto: Further down the light fades. Wrecks, rays and the angel shark appear, still on the sand.
pecio.alt: Life-covered wreck in blue twilight, with an angel shark on the sand, a ray and a diver holding a torch

fondo.texto: Down here you only see what your torch lights up. Time to decide when you're coming down.

experiencias.intro: From your very first breath underwater to the 30-metre wreck. Always with gear, insurance and a professional with you.

puntos.intro: Five sites around the island, chosen every morning according to wind and swell. Tap one to see its details.
puntos.mapa: Illustrated map of Gran Canaria with the dive sites

seguridad.intro: Diving is a sport with risks. That's why what you don't see —ratios, servicing, protocols— is what we care about most.
seguridad.alt: An instructor adjusts a student's mask on the boat deck before the dive

opiniones.titulo: What they say when they surface

reserva.intro: Tell us what you'd like to do and we'll confirm your place within 24 hours. No upfront payment.
reserva.mensajePh: Questions, sizes, if anyone wears glasses…
reserva.privacidad: I have read the privacy policy and agree to my data being used to reply to my booking.
reserva.ok: Got it! We'll write back within 24 hours to confirm your place.
reserva.fallo: We couldn't send the form. Please try again or message us on WhatsApp.

err.fecha: Choose a date from tomorrow onwards.
err.privacidad: We need your consent to be able to reply.
